description_en: Queries the security event types and statistics for API security users
description_zh: 查询API安全用户安全事件类型和统计
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-event-type --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-5y000h0t --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserEventType

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of statuses for security event statistics.
By default, security event data in the toBeConfirmed, confirmed, and actioned statuses is included in the statistics
parameters.help_zh:
安全事件统计的状态列表。
默认统计 toBeConfirmed、confirmed、actioned状态的安全事件数据
parameters.name: user_status_list

parameters.help_en: The dimension of the security event
parameters.name: event_scope
